name: Hu tieu sa te
summary: Hủ tiếu sa tế is one of the bowls Vietnam Tourism names beside soup and dry hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho. Vietnam Tourism does not describe the sa tế, the toppings, or a price.
origin: Mỹ Tho. Vietnam Tourism’s rural page on the noodle village names it as a local bowl.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism names hủ tiếu sa tế with hủ tiếu khô and hủ tiếu xương, and prints no method.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Tourism places the craft in xã Mỹ Phong and neighboring wards of Mỹ Tho. It does not name a street for the sa tế bowl. The address is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Hu tieu sa te in My Tho
seoDescription: Vietnam Tourism names hủ tiếu sa tế beside the Mỹ Tho soup and dry bowls, and prints no method. The price is Check on arrival.
